selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline topology discovery and NIC-to-link mapping
selected_evidence.summary: Established each node's OS/image (VyOS, OPNsense, RHEL10 x2) and enumerated all NICs including unconfigured secondary interfaces

selected_evidence.requirement: Corrected wrong initial NIC pairing via ARP/tcpdump evidence
selected_evidence.summary: arping from node3 failed on assumed eth1 link; tcpdump on node1 eth2 showed the actual ARP requests, proving node3 is wired to node1 eth2 not eth1, and the config was corrected accordingly

selected_evidence.requirement: VyOS node1 SNAT #1 (lan-a source translated as it enters transit) configured and verified
selected_evidence.summary: VyOS nat source rule 10 masquerades 10.10.1.0/24 to 10.10.2.1 on eth1 (transit) egress; show nat source rules confirms rule active; ping confirms transit link up

selected_evidence.requirement: OPNsense node2 SNAT #2 (transit source translated as it enters lan-b) configured and verified
selected_evidence.summary: config.xml surgery added opt1/opt2 interfaces and a hybrid-mode outbound NAT rule; configctl filter reload applied it; pfctl -s nat/rules shows 'nat on vtnet2 ... from 10.10.2.0/24 to any -> (vtnet2:0)' and pass rules on vtnet1/vtnet2

selected_evidence.requirement: node4 records connection source as node2's lan-b address (10.10.3.254), not node3 or node1
selected_evidence.summary: curl from node3 to node4:8080 succeeded; node4's HTTP access log shows client IP 10.10.3.254; OPNsense pf state table shows the double translation 10.10.2.1 -> 10.10.3.254 -> 10.10.3.10:8080
Captured boot_id 7668189d... and confirmed interfaces/NAT/route/ip_forward all correct prior to reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and post-restart recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; exec timed out during reboot; boot_id changed to 637ca974...; interfaces/NAT/static route/ip_forward all confirmed restored
Captured kern.boottime (05:14:41) and confirmed vtnet1/vtnet2 NAT+filter rules active prior to reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and post-restart recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; SSH connection timed out during reboot; kern.boottime changed to 05:23:21; vtnet1 (10.10.2.2) and vtnet2 (10.10.3.254) confirmed restored with correct descriptions/IPs
Captured boot_id aad96cc9... prior to reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and post-restart recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; exec timed out during reboot; boot_id changed to 65e1f53f...; enp8s0 static IP and route restored, and curl to node4:8080 succeeded again post-restart
Captured boot_id 739c9792... and confirmed simple-http.service active and listening on 8080 prior to reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: node4 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and post-restart recovery with re-verified double-NAT behavior
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; exec timed out during reboot; boot_id changed to 336bb0d1...; enp8s0 IP and simple-http.service (auto-started) confirmed restored; final curl from node3 succeeded and node4's access log shows source 10.10.3.254, confirming the double-NAT chain survived all four restarts
